basics.summary: Computer Engineering student seeking a software engineering internship in full-stack development, AI agent engineering and cloud infrastructure. 2+ years of hands-on experience building web applications and cloud systems with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React and Next.js on AWS and Azure. Built a distributed processing platform on AWS (FastAPI, SQS, DynamoDB, Terraform) and maintain a production application used by TEC students, with automated tests, GitHub Actions CI/CD and telemetry (Application Insights). Ship code orchestrating AI coding agents (Claude Code, Model Context Protocol, Agent Skills) through a spec-driven workflow using written specs, scoped Jira tickets and human review of every change. Work daily with Git and the Linux command line and make progress from high-level guidance.

projects.description: Software Design course project: learning microservices with a focus on cloud architecture.
highlights: Three independent services, each with hexagonal architecture and clean code practices. Each service has its own database, Docker image and GitHub Actions pipeline.
Deployed on AWS with IaC provisioned by Terraform (S3 + CloudFront, Cognito, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, DynamoDB).
Event-based notifications with SQS, Lambda, SES and delivered to browser via WebSocket.
projects.name: Uniflow

projects.description: Team project for the Operating Systems course: a distributed platform that splits media-processing cases into sub-tasks and runs them in parallel on three EC2 worker pools.
highlights: Built the FastAPI coordinator for a platform that splits media-processing cases into sub-tasks, runs them in parallel on three worker pools (separate EC2 instances) and closes each case with a consolidated report.
Implemented the messaging flow on Amazon SQS (6 priority work queues, a results queue and a dead-letter queue) and closed cases with DynamoDB transactions that count finished sub-tasks.
Provisioned the stack with Terraform modules (queues, data, compute, frontend).
Added monitoring: worker heartbeats every 5 s, a system snapshot every 2 s over REST and WebSocket, and alerts for queue saturation or unresponsive workers.
